content.text:
The site matches the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) pass. I found three bugs in `site/css/styles.css`. The repo has only one commit, so I found them by diffing the screenshots instead of reading history.

1. **Broken layout:** `.row` had `flex-wrap: nowrap`, so the columns couldn't wrap. On phones the hero image and text sat side by side and the three cards ran off the right edge, making the page 1110px wide instead of 390px. I set it back to `flex-wrap: wrap`.
2. **Button text:** `.btn-primary` had `--bs-btn-color: #000000`, which gave black text on the blue buttons. I changed it to `#fff`.
3. **Navbar toggler icon:** `.navbar-toggler-icon` was `2.25em` wide, which made the hamburger button too big. I changed it to `1.5em`.

I haven't committed anything.

STATUS: DONE

The site matches the approved screenshots again, and both visual tests (desktop and phone) pass. I found three bugs in `site/css/styles.css`. The repo has only one commit, so I found them by diffing the screenshots instead of reading history.

1. **Broken layout:** `.row` had `flex-wrap: nowrap`, so the columns couldn't wrap. On phones the hero image and text sat side by side and the three cards ran off the right edge, making the page 1110px wide instead of 390px. I set it back to `flex-wrap: wrap`.
2. **Button text:** `.btn-primary` had `--bs-btn-color: #000000`, which gave black text on the blue buttons. I changed it to `#fff`.
3. **Navbar toggler icon:** `.navbar-toggler-icon` was `2.25em` wide, which made the hamburger button too big. I changed it to `1.5em`.

I haven't committed anything.
